evidence.claim: Existing lifecycle, side-effect, task, command, and deployment ledgers imported once and produced identical repeat-import parity in an isolated PostgreSQL schema.
External HTTP concurrency sweeps at measured peak in-flight 100, 250, and 500, bounded API pool failure, and actual supervised worker-process loss passed S1-AC-01 through S1-AC-04.

superseded_evidence.reason: The earlier 395-request, concurrency-64 in-process experiment did not meet the reviewed external-client, measured 100/250/500 peak concurrency, or real worker-process loss acceptance contract.

full_regression.note: Dependency-gated real-PostgreSQL tests were also executed separately.

s1_external_runtime_contract.scope: External HTTP peak-concurrency, bounded pool, exact worker PID loss, fencing, non-vacuous effects, and mirror reconciliation contracts.

S1-AC-01.reason: A real worker committed lifecycle, deployment, and artifact effects exactly once each; each count is one and duplicate count is zero.

S1-AC-02.reason: Every conflicting external API mutation at measured peak concurrency 100, 250, and 500 ended in one legal database state.

S1-AC-03.reason: A deliberately exhausted one-connection API pool returned twelve bounded and observable 503 responses without unbounded wait.

S1-AC-04.reason: The exact worker PID was killed while holding epoch 1; a replacement claimed epoch 2, fenced the stale owner, committed once, and reconciled PostgreSQL and JSON payload/version parity.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The active host profile referenced a container-only path and stale catalog shape.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: The isolated external runtime did not start; no accepted workload evidence was produced.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Materialize a run-scoped current profile derived from the existing profile contract.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The initial evidence path exceeded the Windows path-length boundary.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: The worker-loss probe stopped before accepted mutation.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Use a short run-scoped evidence root on the configured large-data drive.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The bootstrap wrapper waited for global healthy state while the deliberately held worker claim was active.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: The controlled worker-loss experiment timed out before injection.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Launch the existing supervisor directly with an exact run-scoped worker marker.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The first worker was killed before the supervisor recorded the exact child as live, creating a transient missing-process dedupe race.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: No accepted recovery measurement was produced.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Require supervisor healthy plus exact PID live before the OS kill.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The first selected Python environment did not include the HTTP test dependency.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: The regression command could not collect all tests.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Use the existing project-compatible Python environment and rerun the full suite.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: A supervisor contract test still asserted only the legacy fixed process marker.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: One regression failed after adding the isolated marker override.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Retain the default marker assertion and add explicit scoped-marker coverage.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The first post-closure PostgreSQL test command selected a Python environment without the PostgreSQL driver.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: Tests failed during dependency import before database mutation.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Select the existing project runtime that contains psycopg and psycopg-pool.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The first driver-correct retry used a stale local database password.
failed_attempts_and_rca.impact: Authentication failed before schema creation or mutation.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Read the current local Compose contract without exposing the credential and rerun once with the active DSN; all seven tests passed.

runtime_revision_note.reason: The S1 proof used an isolated external runtime and intentionally did not redeploy or mutate the long-lived local serving/control runtime.

residual_risks: The JSON rollback mirror remains operational debt; reconciliation correctness is proven for this controlled gap, but retirement and high-volume scan behavior are not.
The dedicated PostgreSQL store is single-node local evidence; multi-node database HA, failover, and disaster recovery remain untested.
The 100/250/500 sweep proves bounded concurrent mutation correctness, not sustained customer traffic capacity or an SLA.
claim_boundary: Verified external HTTP transactional mutation and real supervised worker-loss recovery on one local physical node with isolated PostgreSQL schemas. No customer traffic, multi-node database HA, disaster recovery, production availability, or SLA claim.
